<?php
function peerInstall232() { $GLOBALS['producer'] = new PeerSelectorChild232(false); echo 'FIRST;'; return false; }
function peerShift232() { $GLOBALS['producer'] = null; unset($GLOBALS['producer']); $GLOBALS['late'] = 99; $GLOBALS['owner'] = null; echo 'SHIFT;'; return false; }
class PeerSelectorBase232 {
    public $tag;
    public function __construct($tag) { $this->tag = $tag; echo 'CTOR;'; }
    public static function capture($saved, $marker) { echo 'CAPTURE:', self::class, ':', static::class, ';'; return $saved; }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'SELECTOR-END;'; }
}
class PeerSelectorChild232 extends PeerSelectorBase232 {}
class PeerMagicBase232 {
    public function __call(string $name, array $arguments) { $GLOBALS['kept'] = $arguments['later']; echo 'MAGIC;'; return false; }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'OWNER;'; }
}
class PeerMagicChild232 extends PeerMagicBase232 {}
$owner = new PeerMagicChild232; $producer = null;
$prefix = 'REQUEST-'; $late = $prefix . 'OLD'; $kept = null;
$result = $owner->MiSsInG(first: peerInstall232(), later: ($producer->capture(...))($late, peerShift232()));
echo 'RETURN;'; echo 'VALUE:', $kept, ';'; unset($kept); unset($late); echo 'AFTER;';
